speaker: A1B7Y6W33FM2L8
text: Hello

speaker: A1E77HZO63E334
text: Hey, how is it going?

speaker: A1B7Y6W33FM2L8
text: Im tired but it was a good long weekend.  How was yours?

speaker: A1E77HZO63E334
text: Not bad at all, thanks. Just enjoyed the long weekend as well.

speaker: A1B7Y6W33FM2L8
text: Do you consider yourself a compassionate person?

speaker: A1E77HZO63E334
text: I do, but I also do not want to donate anything today. I really need the money...

speaker: A1B7Y6W33FM2L8
text: That is okay I understand times are tough, but they could be tougher.  I think we get spoiled sometimes of the life we lead.

speaker: A1E77HZO63E334
text: For sure, but I am on the verge of being homeless and this is my only source of income.

speaker: A1B7Y6W33FM2L8
text: To be honest this is one of a few sources I have going but all are online.  Good luck to your future!  So I will donate some of my money today.  I was thinking about doing a dollar but now I am thinking I will give all of it.

speaker: A1E77HZO63E334
text: I appreciate the support. I have a degree, just fell on a tough part in life. You can do that if you want, but I am keeping my full payment. Do you know where the donations go to?

speaker: A1B7Y6W33FM2L8
text: Oh sorry I am not doing my part I forgot to tell you where they are going.  Are you aware of Save the Children?

speaker: A1E77HZO63E334
text: I am not. Can you tell me more please?

speaker: A1B7Y6W33FM2L8
text: They help out in 192 countries and counting.  Their main mission is to ensure children's rights to health, education, safety, etc.  There has been a lack of support for children in developing countries, especially in war zones. For instance, millions of Syrian children have grown up facing the daily threat of violence. In the first two months of 2018 alone, 1,000 children were reportedly killed or injured in intensifying violence.

speaker: A1E77HZO63E334
text: That is awful. Do you have any information on how much of the their funds go to the actual charity part versus the administration, staff, etc?

speaker: A1B7Y6W33FM2L8
text: Yes, about 9 out of 10 dollars go straight to the children while the other dollar would go to making sure that they can expand their capabilities and continue to help

speaker: A1E77HZO63E334
text: That is a very good ratio. Not many charities that are famous to us do that.

speaker: A1B7Y6W33FM2L8
text: It is a very good ration and I love that they are transparent about it.  No pressure here but do you change your mind on donating?  Even if it is a small donation every penny will help these people in need

speaker: A1E77HZO63E334
text: I will donate 25 cents. I wish I could do more.

speaker: A1B7Y6W33FM2L8
text: It is okay, you rock!  The research team will collect all donations and send it to Save the Children after the study is complete.  Have a good one

speaker: A1E77HZO63E334
text: You too, man.
